new_page.description: Hatzic, Mission houses for sale: 18 listed in October 2026, monthly sales and how Hatzic compares with Mission. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Hatzic Houses for Sale | Mission Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Hatzic. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Hatzic, Mission: 18 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 9 Mission communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Mission total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Hatzic fell from 25 in June to 18 in October (−28.0%), and 17 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 8.3% of Mission’s 216 houses listed.
Hatzic home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

27 houses sold in Hatzic with a median price of $985,000 (the middle half sold between $855,000 and $1,289,500), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $444 per square foot, a median year built of 1981 and a median lot of 9,800 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Hatzic?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 18 houses listed in Hatzic. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Hatzic a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Hatzic had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Hatzic from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 17 houses sold in Hatzic over those 5 months, out of 141 in all of Mission.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Hatzic?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Hatzic sell for?
faq.a: 27 houses sold in Hatzic between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $985,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Hatzic?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.5% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
